verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs show it runs as a local server you start yourself (docker run, local-ai run), serving an API at localhost:8080 with a CPU-first path and no GPU required, so inference on your own machine is clearly documented. However, the pack has no explicit statement that prompts and data never leave the device, such as a no-telemetry or offline guarantee, so the privacy half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no prompt/data egress or telemetry occurs, documented fully offline/air-gapped operation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
Every feature ships a CPU path first. That path is tested in CI, on the hardware most people already have, and it is not a degraded fallback.
